name: Cash Grant in lieu of Sewing Machine
benefit:
- A Cash Grant of ₹10,000/- is provided for the purchase of a Sewing Machine.
- The amount is credited to the beneficiary’s Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be the Widow of an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen).- The applicant should be [registered](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure) with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry.- The scope of this scheme will also apply to those ESM / living spouse/widows who are re-employed as regular / deemed to be regular in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Private Organizations and self-employed IT assesses.
